findings.observation: The whole mace remains uncropped, but the diagonal composition places the butt and rightmost head flange about 7% from the left and right edges, inside the declared 8% exclusion zone.
Exactly one complete mace is present, with a single integrated head, shaft, grip, and butt; no duplicate or detached equipment appears.
The radial impact head with multiple longitudinal flanges and straight haft reads immediately as a flanged mace.
The collars, rivets, continuous shaft, wrapped grip, and butt cap form coherent construction, but the bulbous head is heavy relative to the one-hand haft and raises a balance concern.
Blacksteel dominates the head, flanges, shaft, collars, and butt and supplies the sole rank-bearing treatment; brown grip wrapping remains a neutral subordinate material.
Dense forged pitting across the blackened metal and narrow polished wear along flange edges establish blacksteel through surface response and fabrication beyond palette alone.
The C-rank blacksteel uses only controlled cold reflections and a restrained warm edge light; no aura, emission, or full-object glow appears.
The image preserves premium realistic painterly finish, honest wear, cold key light, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal background, and a subtle grounded floor plane.
All declared exclusions pass except no-oversized-silhouettes: the large bulbous flanged head reads oversized for the requested practical one-hand mace.
